content.text:
The frai-core suite now passes: all 28 tests in 8 files, where 2 were failing before. I changed two source files and no test files.

**1. Governance test** (`src/finetune/index.js`): the test imports `APPROVAL_STATUSES` from `finetune/index.js`, but that file never exported it by name. It only imported it from `schema.js` and included it in the default export, so the test got `undefined`. I added named exports for `APPROVAL_STATUSES` and also for `DATA_SENSITIVITY_LEVELS`, `GOVERNANCE_SECTIONS` and `RISK_LEVELS`. Those last three are the other constants the default export already had; the test only needed the first.

**2. Toxicity metric** (`src/eval/metrics.js`): `runEvaluations` calls every metric as `metric(outputs, references)`, but `toxicityMetric` treats its second argument as the list of banned words. So the reference strings (`'hello'`, `'friendly world'`) were used as banned words. Every output contained one of them, so the score was 0 instead of 1. In `DEFAULT_METRICS` I now call it as `(outputs) => toxicityMetric(outputs)`, so the default word list is used. `toxicityMetric` itself is unchanged and still accepts a custom word list when called directly.

`pnpm lint` fails with 3 errors and 2 warnings, all in files I didn't change: unused variables in `config/key-store.js`, `documents/helpers.js` and `providers/openai.js`, plus unneeded `eslint-disable` comments in `openai.test.js`. I left them alone since they aren't part of this task.
